answer: Each identity locks one jade bond on a mesa, slashed if two identities share a device or IP. The mesa holds only M bonds, so each fake past M pays an auction premium doubling per slot. Between closes, each identity must graze the meadow by answering a random liveness ping within 60 seconds; two misses forfeit the bond. N fakes need N bonds, N rising premiums and N devices, so cost grows faster than N, and one reused device loses every bond.
